gaps.title: Body text size apart from density
gaps.note: 17px everywhere the Guardian sets running text and controls: article copy (Guardian Text Egyptian 17/400), button labels, field values, the football select and the support picker

gaps.title: Button height apart from density
gaps.note: Source buttons are 44px by default, 36px small and 24px x-small; fields and the football select are 44px too
gaps.standin: `density: touch`: 48px buttons and fields (spacious would be 40px at 14px text)

gaps.title: Button inline padding
gaps.note: 20px on 44px buttons (16px small, 12px x-small)

gaps.title: Field height between the control steps
gaps.note: 44px gateway field and football select
gaps.standin: 48px at touch, as tall as buttons

gaps.title: Narrower field inset
gaps.note: Fields and the select pad 8px

gaps.title: Field label size apart from the control text
gaps.note: Labels are 17/700, the field text's size

gaps.title: Heading weight apart from the title style
gaps.note: GH Guardian Headline at 500 for article and card headlines (34px, 20px), 700 for container and gateway titles (24px, 28px)

gaps.title: Heading sizes on their own scale
gaps.note: Article headline 34px (28px on features), gateway title 28px, container title 24px, card headline 20px

gaps.title: Body copy in a serif reading face while the UI stays sans
gaps.note: Article paragraphs are Guardian Text Egyptian 17/400 (#121212 / #dcdcdc); captions, buttons, fields, labels, menus and tags set Guardian Text Sans
gaps.standin: `readingFont: Literata` reaches chat messages only, so body copy renders in Hanken Grotesk

gaps.title: Checked checkboxes keep a clear box
gaps.note: Source's checked box stays white inside a 2px #0077b6 edge with a blue tick
gaps.standin: A solid #0077b6 box with a white tick

gaps.title: Checkbox and radio size apart from density
gaps.note: 24px checkboxes at 4px corners, 22px radios (20px checked, inside a 2px edge)
gaps.standin: 16px at touch, 2px corners (the detail rung under 4px fields)

gaps.title: Checked radio edge
gaps.note: A 2px #0077b6 ring around the dot

gaps.title: Switch on in the success color
gaps.note: ToggleSwitch turns success green #22874d when on, over a #707070 off track

gaps.title: Quiet buttons in the link color
gaps.note: The subdued priority is a navy #052962 17/700 label with an underline and no plate

gaps.title: Quiet buttons with less inline padding than filled ones at the same height
gaps.note: Subdued buttons are 44px tall with no inline padding and square corners

gaps.title: Outline buttons edged and labelled in the brand
gaps.note: Source's tertiary priority is white inside a 1px #052962 edge under a #052962 17/700 label (the gateway's Continue with Google); in dark it sits on the black page inside a #999999 edge under white
gaps.standin: `buttonSecondary: outline`: a 1px gray edge (oklch 0.6) under an ink label, tinted in dark

gaps.title: A brand primary that turns light in dark, labelled in the brand
gaps.note: The gateway's Continue with email is #052962 under white in light and #ffffff under #052962 in dark (DCR's article primary is #dcdcdc under #052962)

gaps.title: Tab height apart from density
gaps.note: Most viewed tabs are 28px of label under a 4px top bar

gaps.title: Line tabs marked on top
gaps.note: The current Most viewed tab carries a 4px inset bar along its top edge, with no fill, and 1px #dcdcdc / #333333 rules stand between the tabs

gaps.title: Tab labels in the heading font
gaps.note: Most viewed tabs set GH Guardian Headline at 17/600, while buttons and fields set Guardian Text Sans

gaps.title: Row, tab and segmented ink at rest
gaps.note: Tabs at rest keep full ink #121212 / #dcdcdc; only the top bar marks the current one
gaps.standin: Muted ink on tabs at rest

gaps.title: Links and tags in the section accent
gaps.note: Article links and keyword tags take the pillar color (news #c70000, opinion #e05e00, sport #0077b6, culture #866d50, lifestyle #bb3b80) in light and go neutral #dcdcdc (tags #ff5943) in dark; gateway and support links are #0077b6 at 700
gaps.standin: Links in the brand's accent step, tags neutral

gaps.title: Cards drawn as a top rule only
gaps.note: Front cards have no fill, edge or corners, only a 1px #bababa rule above the headline (newsletter cards are square #f6f6f6 tiles)
gaps.standin: `roleCard: none`: square cards that keep their edge

gaps.title: Edged overlays over edgeless cards, with no drop
gaps.note: The edition menu is white inside a 1px navy #042458 edge plus a 10% black ring, with no drop shadow

gaps.title: Overlay shadow per kind
gaps.note: The edition menu has no drop shadow
gaps.standin: The menu keeps its small drop

gaps.title: Hairlines between dropdown options
gaps.note: Edition menu rows are separated by 1px rules

gaps.title: Wider menu label inset
gaps.note: Edition menu labels sit 30px in, after the leading tick's column

gaps.title: Menu row type
gaps.note: Edition menu rows are 15/400, a step under the 17px control text

gaps.title: Outline fields clear in dark
gaps.note: Dark fields are page-colored: #1a1a1a on DCR, #000000 on the gateway
gaps.standin: `inputStyle: outline`, which tints fields in dark

gaps.title: Focused field edge in a neutral step while the ring carries the color
gaps.note: The field edge stays #707070 (#999999 in dark) under the focus halo
gaps.standin: The edge recolors to the focus color

gaps.title: Focus ring width and offset per control
gaps.note: Source's `focusHaloSpaced` on buttons is a 5px #0077b6 outline 3px out; its `focusHalo` on fields a 3px solid shadow flush with the edge
gaps.standin: `focusWidth: 4` (its maximum) at the default 2px gap on buttons; `focusInputStyle: ring` puts the same ring on fields instead of a flush 3px band

gaps.title: Badge shape, case and weight per tone
gaps.note: Keyword tags are outlined pills at 14/400; the support site's Recommended label is a solid #0077b6 box at 4px corners, 15/700

gaps.title: Badge size apart from density
gaps.note: Tags are 24px padded 9px; Recommended is 29.5px padded 16px

gaps.title: Badge label weight apart from the button weight
gaps.note: Tags 14/400, Recommended 15/700

gaps.title: Alert edge thicker than the hairline
gaps.note: Source's InfoSummary draws a 2px #0077b6 edge at 4px corners around black text on the page, with no fill

gaps.title: Alert text in pure black
gaps.note: InfoSummary text is #000000, darker than the #121212 page ink; only the edge and icon take the blue

gaps.title: Segmented track in the brand
gaps.note: The support site's Monthly / Annual picker is a square 46px #052962 band, its items #a2b2cb under navy 17/700 labels with 36px padding, the current one a white chip at 12px corners
gaps.standin: A gray track; `segmentedSelected: ring` gives the white chip but adds a gray ring

gaps.title: Segmented control height
gaps.note: The support picker is 46px with items filling it, padded 36px
gaps.standin: A 52px track around 44px items padded 16px at touch

gaps.title: Segmented item weight
gaps.note: 17/700 labels

gaps.title: Square segmented track around a rounder chip
gaps.note: The navy band is square while the current option is a 12px chip

gaps.title: Form text in the brand ink
gaps.note: The gateway's page title (28/700), field labels (17/700) and field values are navy #052962, as are the support site's segmented labels, while article text is #121212
